tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. The default surface; white in light, deep navy in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Input wells, chips, table stripes and the quietest card fill, on canvas.

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Tinted section background and the circle behind a service icon. The only non-white section surface.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px borders on cards, inputs and dividers, on canvas, surface and ice.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and emphasized text on canvas, surface and ice. 16:1 on white.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Body copy on canvas, surface and ice. 7.0:1 on white, 11:1 on dark canvas.

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: Captions, hours, helper text at 14px and up, on canvas, surface and ice. 4.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The logo's ink. Hero band, appointment band and utility bar fill in both themes; headings use ink instead.

tokens.name: navy-deep
tokens.usage: Footer surface and the dark end of any navy gradient.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on navy and navy-deep.

tokens.name: on-navy-soft
tokens.usage: Body text, labels and dividers on navy and navy-deep. 9.5:1 on navy.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Eye Site Blue, the working brand color. Links, eyebrows, icons, secondary button outlines, active nav, stat numbers, on canvas, surface and ice. 6.2:1 on white.

tokens.name: blue-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of blue text and outlines. The SACRAMENTO wordmark color.

tokens.name: blue-figure
tokens.usage: Top of the logo figure's gradient. Illustration and chart fill only, never text.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Middle of the logo figure's gradient. Card hover border, chart fills, the quote mark on review posts. Never text on white.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Bottom of the logo figure's gradient. Dividers and secondary text on navy, the focus halo around inputs. Never text on white.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a blue fill.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The one accent. Primary button fill, active nav underline, the amber rule on social posts. One amber element per view. Carries on-amber text, never white.

tokens.name: amber-deep
tokens.usage: Hover state of an amber fill.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Amber as text, on canvas, ice or amber-pale (a 'New patients welcome' chip). 5.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: amber-pale
tokens.usage: Tint behind amber-ink chips and callouts.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an amber fill. 8.1:1 on amber.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations and accepted states as text or icon on canvas and surface, always with a word or check icon. 5.4:1 on white.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Form validation border and helper text on canvas, always with text that says what to fix. 5.3:1 on white.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Homepage hero headline, one italic word. Fluid from 52px to 88px with the viewport; 46 to 60px on phones.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles and social post headlines. 38px on mobile.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, doctor names, feature panel titles.

styles.name: display-italic
styles.usage: The single emphasized word inside a display or h1 headline, set in blue on light surfaces and mist on navy.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers in stat tiles, set in blue with tabular figures.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Comprehensive eye care from routine exams to advanced surgery.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a page or section heading, light weight.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Our office provides a full range of services, from routine eye care to advanced medical and surgical treatment.
styles.usage: Default body copy at light weight. Measure 65ch. Sized for readers over 60; never lighter than 300, never smaller than 18px on a page.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Free parking is available at both locations.
styles.usage: Dense copy, footer text, form fields and card bodies, at regular weight so it stays legible small.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, hours, helper text. Minimum web text size.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Doctor names in cards, phone numbers in the appointment band, form section titles.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels, uppercase and tracked. Labels are verbs.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Nav links and tabs, uppercase and tracked. Form labels use it in sentence case with no tracking.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase overlines in blue (mist on navy), tracked wide, echoing the spaced SACRAMENTO in the logo.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips, between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding, list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between related elements.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, grid gutters, logo clear space.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section; appointment band padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop; social post safe margin.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Maximum section padding on wide screens; the hero's bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small thumbnails, chips inside tables.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, doctor portraits, images, the logo tile on navy.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Appointment band, feature panels, modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, nav pills.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Card hover and the scrolled nav bar. A resting card has a hairline border and no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-floating
tokens.usage: The trust panel floating over the hero, dropdowns, dialogs and toasts.

duration.note: Motion values. Every entrance uses ease-out cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); every pressable element scales to 0.97 on :active. See the README's Motion section.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Tooltips, hover color changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Button press, card hover, dropdown open.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Modal and mobile nav sheet enter. Exits are faster than enters.
